core_obligations: Prove essential surjectivity by algebraizing (F_n) to a coherent sheaf F on U
Verify the (2,3)-inequalities hypothesis of the algebraization results
Upgrade F to finite locally free near U_0 via stalk-completion comparison

proof_roadmap.step: Take a finite locally free object (F_n) of Coh(U, fO_U)
Apply Lemma algebraization-principal-bis or Proposition cd-1 to obtain F with completion (F_n)
Compare the f-adic completion of each stalk F_y with a finite free module over the completed local ring to get finite locally free on a neighbourhood U' of U_0

difficulty_reason: The retained proof carries essential surjectivity in full: given a finite locally free object (F_n) of Coh(U, fO_U), it produces a coherent F on U via Lemma algebraization-principal-bis or Proposition cd-1, checks the only missing hypothesis (the (2,3)-inequalities) by citing Lemma unwinding-conditions-bis, then upgrades F to finite locally free on an open neighbourhood of U_0 by comparing stalk completions with finite free modules. Fully faithfulness is delegated to Lemma fully-faithful-general with the delegation named; the load-bearing half of the equivalence is in the span. Retained author proof at lines 8115-8131.
